records.title: Dedicated canonical report stylesheet
records.requirement: Maintain a dedicated Atlas stylesheet derived from the reviewed shared design. Embed the canonical UTF-8 LF representation in the standalone HTML; do not require a separate stylesheet or invent local visual overrides.

sources.quote: Canonical shared stylesheet for langgraph-business-understanding.html reports.
The atlas must reuse the shared report visual system instead of inventing local styling.

records.title: Navigable native report sections
records.requirement: Organize complete report information into navigable details/summary sections. Keep a concise overview open and preserve native disclosure without requiring executable scripts.

sources.quote: Atlas readers need navigable sections, not one long wall of HTML.

records.title: Behavior understanding before class inventory
records.requirement: Explain existing source-backed behavior using actors, intent, operations, meaningful objects and observed or source-reviewed outcomes. Keep dependency and class inventories separate. When behavior is unknown, expose the limit instead of manufacturing a flow.

sources.quote: A business atlas without business flow diagrams is only a test inventory.

records.title: Reopen claims from exact source and oracle evidence
records.requirement: Bind claims, behavior transitions and available test oracles to exact source fragments and useful line ranges. State missing or unexecuted oracles explicitly; related governance is not complete coverage of every clause.

sources.quote: Rows must expose a repeatable mapping shape so the atlas is auditable.

records.title: Preserve analyzed project ownership
records.requirement: Analyze the selected project read only unless the task authorizes a specific edit. Preserve concurrent work and publish generated documents in the caller-selected artifact area.

sources.quote: The atlas skill is analysis-only; changing analyzed sources violates the contract.

records.title: Complete self-contained understanding document
records.requirement: Deliver one complete business understanding HTML that remains readable offline. Preserve complete source traces, original documents, retrieved policy and execution evidence in the separate adjacent audit; never truncate or discard them. Missing facts stay visible in reader limits. The HTML does not embed raw technical inputs.

sources.quote: ATLAS-READER-001: Publish business understanding in one numbered offline HTML; preserve source, commands, file verification, raw JSON and execution evidence in a separate adjacent audit, never hidden in the reader.

records.title: Exactly one understanding HTML per invocation
records.requirement: For one selected project, publish exactly one complete understanding HTML in its delivery directory. Keep audit sidecars outside delivery and preserve exactly one project/revision identity; never blend another project's facts or execution proof. This applies to ATF and non-ATF projects.

sources.quote: Each invocation publishes exactly one complete understanding HTML for exactly one selected project.

records.title: Adapt to the actual selected project
records.requirement: Detect the actual project language, build system, components and proof scope. Never reuse an ATF module graph for an unrelated project. A source-only project with no tests or Git is valid with explicit unknown identity or missing oracle. A single component and zero declared edges must remain truthful. Use oracleStatus NOT_FOUND and an UNKNOWN oracle claim when no oracle is available; do not invent a test suite.

sources.quote: The selected project may use any language or build system, or have no tests or Git metadata.

records.title: Canonical English authored report
records.requirement: Keep authored report prose, code and comments English. Preserve exact external source excerpts and original retained evidence as attributed data instead of silently translating source facts. Keep the framework root README focused on project orientation without translated branch routes; edition administration belongs to its dedicated guide.

sources.quote: The final document is English; code and comments remain English.
DOC-ROOT-FOCUS-001: The root README routes project decisions to owner guides; keep translated branch names and URLs in the edition guide, including references in comments and encoded examples.

records.title: Execution verdict and captured source identity
records.requirement: Separate source review, real execution, historical reports and unknowns. Preserve actual XML/TAP counters and verdicts plus the original executed source manifest. A passing consistency check cannot relabel a failed run or certify later edits.

sources.quote: execution stays FAILED even if consistency verification passes.

records.title: No invented assessment score
records.requirement: State in reader language when no project-quality grade was authored. Keep detailed assessment inputs and machine review states in the adjacent audit. Never infer a maturity or understanding score from passing checks, identity, retrieval relevance or source-file counts; a separate authored assessment retains its own scope.

sources.quote: ATLAS-READER-004: Explain verification and assessment limits in reader language; do not infer a project quality grade from consistency, retrieval or passing checks.

records.title: Human review owns semantic correspondence
records.requirement: Treat structural validation and source/evidence identity as bounded consistency checks. A reviewer still verifies meaning, graph correspondence and proof limits; matching keywords do not establish semantic truth or complete coverage.

sources.quote: identity and structure; it cannot infer that prose is true from matching words.

records.title: Readable supporting graph relationships
records.requirement: Use visible minimal SVG shapes, understandable relationship labels and arrowheads. Inspect real desktop rendering for overlap, clipped labels and ambiguous direction; valid markup alone is insufficient. Require SOURCE_GRAPH_V1 for the current reader: preserve full source/domain relationship labels and arrow direction, distinguish actual refusal boundaries from future frontiers, use calm shared primitives, consistent scale, compact horizontal layouts and closed local bullet legends. Audit actual native labels, endpoints, outlines, arrowheads, overlap and clipping; never replace a long relationship with a generic observe label. Adapt archive guidance to the current English audience and keep raw technical proof outside the HTML.

sources.quote: supportingGraphEdgesRequireArrowheads: true
supportingGraphEdgesRequireRelationshipLabels: true

ATLAS-DIAGRAM-001: Recover the archived shared visual grammar through source-specific readable nodes, complete relationship labels and arrowheads, horizontal dependency direction, compact supporting graphs, closed local bullet legends and honest boundary cues; compare the actual native graph with source endpoints and reject overlaps, clipping, missing cues and generic label substitution.
Graphs should reuse the proven html-ex visual primitives.
Business nodes must represent actors, decisions, owned objects, and observable outcomes.

records.title: Actionable visual governance failures
records.requirement: A failure must identify the observed missing graph or evidence property and give an owned repair route and recheck selection. Preserve original evidence and distinguish a repair suggestion from an established root cause.

sources.quote: supporting graph edges missing arrowheads
supporting graph missing relationship labels

records.title: Declared source-backed understanding breadth
records.requirement: Declare PROJECT or SELECTED understanding scope from actual source-owner inventory. Review purpose, structure, behavior, data, configuration, failure and verification per unit with evidence-backed REVIEWED/PARTIAL or explicit UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE. Align owner units, architecture nodes and existing flows without inferring semantic completeness from indexed files.

sources.quote: A full source inventory is not a declaration of complete semantic understanding.

records.title: Exact retained behavior and oracle testcase subjects
records.requirement: An EXECUTED behavior or oracle claim binds every referenced run to an exact retained XML classname/name or flat Node TAP test name, a source path already quoted by the claim and its original outcome. Preserve source-manifest and counter checks. Missing, duplicated, ambiguous, skipped or TODO subjects cannot prove execution; source-only projects retain explicit oracle gaps.

sources.quote: An executed behavior or oracle claim requires executionSubjects bound to retained testcase identities and outcomes.

records.title: Scoped evidence-bound quality review axes
records.requirement: When an authored assessment is requested, separate project quality from Atlas quality. Declare reviewer, scope, rationale and limits; cite reviewed claims and any retained execution. Use integer 1–100 correctness/verification/clarity inputs and a 40/30/30 score, with axis weights totaling 100 per group. Do not derive a score from gate success or claim automatic semantic coverage or human approval. Without assessment display NOT_ASSESSED.

sources.quote: An assessment is a scoped authored review, not a test pass rate or an automatic score.

records.title: Existing positive and negative behavior case witnesses
records.requirement: For each new behavior capture declare actual positive/negative cases with preconditions, triggers, expected observations, contiguous node/edge walks, local source claims and exact existing oracle sourceRef indices. Explain reviewed negative scope or an evidence-backed searched gap; NOT_FOUND keeps an UNKNOWN oracle and source search evidence. Do not invent tests or infer case kind from names.

sources.quote: Negative observations are explicit reviewed cases or an evidence-backed search gap, never inferred from a happy-path diagram.

records.title: Reachable outcomes and bounded graph traversal
records.requirement: Every behavior node must be reachable from the declared entry and able to reach an OUTCOME, and every declared OUTCOME needs a source-bound case witness. Validate finite contiguous case walks and declared edge coverage without enumerating every loop schedule. Supported cycles remain valid; disconnected operations and trapped cycles fail. Keep dependency graphs separate and preserve semantic-review limits.

sources.quote: Every declared behavior outcome has a source-bound case witness reachable from its entry.

records.title: Business audience and governed numbering
records.requirement: Use renderer 5 business projection with source-bound capabilities, meaningful positive and negative cases, visible unknowns, and ordered hierarchical section numbering mirrored in navigation. Keep SSH, commands, file checks, raw JSON and proof payloads outside the HTML, including hidden templates. Preserve the adjacent audit, component negative/repair controls and native desktop render review; semantic meaning still needs a reviewer. Calibrate the actual artifact against live source and project documentation: follow delegation to implementation, separate expected cases from actual recorded verdicts, expose partial review depth, exercise native navigation from closed sections, and inspect source-bound architecture/behavior diagrams and adjacent legends. Keep known masking and sharing limits explicit; metadata does not attest semantic truth.

sources.quote: ATLAS-READER-002: Use stable ordered section numbers mirrored in navigation, hierarchical child numbers, valid local anchors and adjacent diagram legends; keep concise explanations, meaningful cases and balanced tables.

ATLAS-READER-003: Retrieve mandatory audience and numbering policy, author the project-specific projection from actual source, preserve negative controls and repairs, verify the adjacent audit, and inspect native rendering before selecting the final reader.

ATLAS-CALIBRATION-001: Audit the actual rendered artifact against live source and project documentation; distinguish expected behavior from recorded verdicts, expose partial review, test native navigation, and retain source-bound architecture and behavior diagrams with adjacent legends.

records.title: Scoped semantic qualification and compact identity
records.requirement: For semantic qualification require SEMANTIC_FACETS_V1: distinct facet observations, explicit reviewed scope and limits, owned source fragments and independent existing oracles. Bind executed facet oracles to their original testcase identities. Review actual data relationships, initialization, caching and failure paths; passing one narrow oracle never proves a broader guarantee. Keep partial scopes visible. Use one compact Atlas/project identity line, no redundant English badge, with actual native geometry checks. Inventory size and passing tests do not compute semantic completeness or a quality grade.

sources.quote: ATLAS-SEMANTICS-001: Qualify semantic understanding through distinct scoped facet observations, owned implementation fragments and independent existing oracles; preserve remaining boundaries and verify the actual visible facet projection instead of inferring completeness from source inventory or test counts.

ATLAS-IDENTITY-001: Use one compact Atlas and project-title line without a redundant language badge; retain review date with confidence, preserve readable text and measure the actual rendered header at both desktop widths.

records.title: Preserved semantic baseline and evidence of actual progress
records.requirement: For refinement preserve the original adjacent audit as semantic-baseline.json with its exact digest and revision. Compare all original facet states. Investigate every previously partial facet once, retain its original scope and limits in the new dossier, and require additional owned implementation plus independent oracle fragments before promotion. Never count scope deletion, changed wording or recycled old receipts as progress. Distinguish component SDK configuration from actual pixels or an operating-system matrix; keep application cleanup and unsupported data guarantees visible. For successive BOUNDED_OBSERVATIONS_V2 reviews retain earlier proof boundaries against the actual prior audit. Bind new proof to additional oracle fragments. Expose remaining questions and evidence boundaries for partial application behavior and data, collapsed by default. Input shape, local rejection and immutable copies do not establish deployment persistence, global uniqueness or data deletion; these limits are not new product-flow tasks.

sources.quote: ATLAS-REFINEMENT-001: Compare every original partial facet with the preserved baseline audit, retain its original scope and limits, record the investigated question and decision, and require additional owned implementation and independent oracle fragments before promotion; scope deletion or recycled receipts cannot count as progress.

ATLAS-SUCCESSIVE-001: Preserve prior observation proofs against the actual baseline, bind each new proof to its additional oracle fragments, and keep partial application facets explicit through source-bound remaining questions; local input or validation checks do not establish deployment persistence, global uniqueness or data deletion.

records.title: Bounded previews, image payloads and local versus application proof
records.requirement: For observation refinement declare BOUNDED_OBSERVATIONS_V1 and a proof boundary on every investigated facet. Component claims need their actual named passing oracle execution; source-only observations remain partial. Follow the live shared response projection: whitespace normalization and bounded previews do not preserve a complete raw body. Image bytes do not prove page layout, masking or pixel meaning. Request association does not establish every delayed event or redirect. Local validation, randomized contacts and flat resource lookup do not establish remote persistence, global uniqueness or account cleanup. Preserve original scope, limits and explicit non-claims in the reader and native comparison.

sources.quote: ATLAS-OBSERVATION-001: Separate observed response fields and bounded previews from complete payloads, image bytes from pixel meaning, and local component validation from application acceptance; a reviewed observation facet needs original passing component oracle subjects and explicit non-claims, while additional source-only observations remain partial.
